cost_basket.drink_out_eur: domestic draught beer 0.5L at a bar
cost_basket.grocery_day_eur: one person, one day of self-catering groceries

cost_validation.method: Belgium baseline x Eurostat restaurants&hotels PLI, validated vs Numbeo anchors

accommodation_model.assumptions: entire home/apt; stored value is the annual median base nightly per person (whole-home median / capacity). Runtime adds seasonality, a weekly discount, an amortised cleaning fee and the service fee.

accommodation_validation.method: Belgium baseline x Eurostat restaurants&hotels PLI, validated vs Inside Airbnb anchors

car_model.notes: Fuel computed at runtime from home->dest haversine x detour. Petrol EUR/L: EU-27 from EC Oil Bulletin (Jun 2026, EUR), non-EU from globalpetrolprices.com x 0.862; rental EUR/day from tripbudgetcalculator.com (2026) x 0.862 (annual midpoints; a depart-month seasonality x0.85-1.25 is applied at runtime so summer trips price near each range's top). Estimates.

flight_model.method: real per-day Ryanair fares from the farefinder cheapestPerDay endpoint; only days that are actually bookable are kept (soldOut/unavailable days are omitted, so a route that does not operate on a date simply has no fare and won't be priced).

components.heritage: UNESCO World Heritage Sites within ~60 km (mid ring 60-120 km at 0.4); saturating
components.beach: Blue Flag national beach density gated by the destination's coast/beach/island tags
components.iconic: iconic tag + curated famously-stunning spots + Most Beautiful Villages members

beauty_model.scale: score 0-10; gems 1-5 by dataset quantiles (cutoffs in gem_cutoffs)

image_model.license: per-image (Wikimedia Commons); page linked for attribution

activities_model.note: OpenTripMap when OPENTRIPMAP_KEY set; else Wikivoyage See/Do + city-centre Wikipedia geosearch
